gui.aelysiummod.raca.humano.descricao:
A race descended from the Elvarin that lost its magical traits long ago. Without the longevity and markings of their ancestors, Humans learned to survive on their own. Some founded their own colonies, but they can still be found wandering the lands of other races.

They are known for their vast range of knowledge, gained mostly through teamwork. Their short lives made them persistent and adaptable, and it is in unity that they find the strength to stand equal to the older peoples.

Traits: Ordinary humans, without many striking features.
gui.aelysiummod.raca.elvarin.descricao:
A race descended from the Primordial, long-lived and pointy-eared. Each Elvarin has different customs because their ancestors lived in different regions of the planet, with many kinds of knowledge gathered through generations of tales of devotion.

This heritage gives them a connection to the nature around them far more intense than to any other element. Living for centuries, they watch the seasons change and kingdoms rise and fall, keeping a patient wisdom and deep respect for everything that blooms. To them, time is a calm river, and haste is a habit of other peoples.

Traits: Pointy ears, fantasy skin color (optional), forest-style clothing.
gui.aelysiummod.raca.faunari.descricao:
A race closely bound to land animals and to nature, born from the Elvarin and bearing traits of their animal of origin in humanoid form. Born from the will of the God of Nature, the Faunari live among the other races as if they had always been by their side, in remarkable harmony with the peoples around them.

Known for their agile reflexes and keen senses, many can still talk to animals, as if the ancestral bond from the day they were born had never broken. Each carries the spirit of the animal that originated them, reflected in their customs and temperament.

Traits: Skin with fur or a few feathers, clawed paws (optional), body with animal details (humanoid appearance).
gui.aelysiummod.raca.dracono.descricao:
An honorable race that resembles a humanoid with Dragon traits. Their skin is covered in fine scales, with a leather-like texture in dark colors, and depending on the bloodline, some have a majestic tail as a symbol of the ancestral blood running in their veins. Their eyes shine intensely in the face of great challenges.

For a long time, honor has been tied to their history, and they treat everyone with courtesy and respect. Many set out on adventures to find themselves, believing that only through great journeys can they honor the name of their ancestors.

Traits: Scaled skin, horns and long tails (humanoid appearance).
gui.aelysiummod.raca.tiefling.descricao:
A mixed race born from a forbidden relationship, many bloodlines ago, between the different races of the world and the descendants of Demons. They are humanoids with horns of varying shapes and skin in non-verdant tones, carrying a heritage they never asked for but which shaped their history.

Tieflings are not predisposed to evil alignments and vary almost as widely as humans, struggling to forge their own path in an environment that fears them and condemns them at the same time. To them, destiny is not defined by the origin of their ancestors, but by the choices of each day.

Traits: Curved horns and a thin tail in reddish or black tones, pointy ears (optional).
gui.aelysiummod.raca.undyne.descricao:
An amphibious race with marine traits such as scales ranging from blue to green or gray tones, and some even having gills. They move gracefully on land and in water, and many never feel completely at ease far from the sound of the waves.

Originating from the depths, with a code of honor inherited from submerged clans, they keep a strong connection to the waters and are known for their determination and firm bearing. They walk among the surface peoples as explorers, driven by curiosity about the world beyond the sea and by the wish to bring their clans the stories of their discoveries.

Traits: Scaled skin, fins and gills, skin color in aquatic tones (humanoid appearance).
gui.aelysiummod.raca.valkyria.descricao:
A race easily recognized by the small delicate wings that sprout from both their feet and the sides of their head, giving them an ethereal and agile appearance. Mystic by nature, they devote their faith to the Moon Goddess, believing her silver light guides their paths and strengthens their powers, especially on full moon nights, when their wings seem to glow softly.

Revered for their wisdom and spiritual connection to the lunar cycles, they live in harmony with the night, cultivating ancient traditions that celebrate the moon in all its phases, with chants and vigils under the starry sky.

Traits: An angelic being with small wings on either the feet or the head, and optionally on the back.
gui.aelysiummod.raca.robo.descricao: Machines built to fight. No hunger, only energy.
